exposure: extensively hydrolyzed casein formula (EHCF) in combination with Lactobacillus rhamnosus GG (LGG)
cohort: The study included children in their first year of life with a positive history of cow's milk allergy (CMA) who were treated with EHCF alone or with LGG, and who had acquired immune tolerance to cow's milk for at least 12 months, along with a control cohort of healthy children.
finding: The rate of functional gastrointestinal disorders (FGIDs) was significantly lower in the EHCF+LGG cohort compared with the EHCF-alone cohort.
